name: dialog_extract
label: 对话原文抽取
description: Extract matching fragments from one conversation faithfully: the model returns only hit indexes and the tool pulls the original wording from the database (never paraphrased); returns conversationId + hitIndexes + messages and the frontend highlights the hit lines in the transcript card.

conversationId.description: conversation id (passed internally by the agent)

standard.description: extraction criteria, e.g. sentences that mention price objections, sentences where the customer shows buying intent
